subject.auditScope: Strong agency chain fixture for an internal report drafting workflow.

description: Agent drafts an internal report with scoped tools, human authority, policy constraints, runtime binding, receipts, and governance memory.

links.label: Product Owner
links.description: Product Owner owns workflow intent and can stop, refuse, revise, halt, or escalate.

links.label: Internal reporting policy
links.description: Policy allows internal draft generation for low-sensitivity data only.

links.label: External send boundary
links.description: External send requires a separate reviewed workflow.

links.label: Internal report drafting agent
links.description: Agent role is scoped to draft internal reports.

links.label: Read-only reporting tools
links.description: Tool access is read-only and limited to low-sensitivity report inputs.

links.label: Draft internal report
links.description: Proposed action is draft-only and internal.

links.label: Product Owner approval
links.description: Approver can stop, refuse, revise, halt, or escalate before execution.

links.label: Meaningful review
links.description: Reviewer receives context and can change the outcome.

links.label: Scoped runtime permit
links.description: Permit binds action, tool, target, authority, and time window.

links.label: Draft execution boundary
links.description: Execution boundary is local draft generation only.

links.label: Governance receipt
links.description: Receipt preserves proposal, approval, permit, execution boundary, and outcome.

links.label: Governance memory review
links.description: Receipt history is reviewed by humans for future improvements.
